_doc: Classes (BL4 style): each tree has its own action skill; you equip one (loadout.action = tree id). Passives (points, ranks) are generic ability.* / player.* stats and work with whichever skill is equipped. Augments are free: a tree's augment unlocks when the tree reaches its tier; up to augmentSlots are equipped, from the equipped skill's tree. One capstone (a point, any tree) works with whichever skill is equipped. Tiers open every `tierPoints` points spent in that tree.

classes.name: Pilot
classes.tagline: Call down a mech. Two arms, two weapons, one integrity bar.

chaingun.name: Thresher Chaingun
chaingun.desc: Hold to spin up and fire a stream of heavy rounds.

rail.name: Longbow Rail
rail.desc: Hold to charge, release to fire a beam that pierces every zombie in a line. A full charge hits far harder.

salvo.name: Quad Rocket Pod
salvo.desc: Four dumbfire rockets per pull, each with its own blast.

thermite.name: Thermite Launcher
thermite.desc: Lobs a thermite shell that bursts into a pool of fire, burning zombies that walk through it.

fist.desc: A piston-driven punch that crushes everything in front of you and throws the rest back.

arc.desc: Hold to throw a lightning arc at the nearest zombie in front of you; it jumps to more nearby.

action.name: Call In Mech
action.desc: Call a mech down from orbit: it crushes what it lands on and you climb in. Left click fires the left arm, right click the right arm; each weapon has its own heat. Hits land on the mech, not you: every hit takes time off its integrity bar, and when the bar runs out you eject. Press again to eject early.
